insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_text: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer. The waiting period shall decrease to 30 months / 24 months subject to optional buy-back endorsement where premium load is accepted upon underwriting.
impact_summary: Pre-existing diabetes, hypertension, or CAD requiring hospitalization within the first 36 months is not covered unless continuous coverage tenure exceeds 36 months.

insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_text: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising from accidental injury. This exclusion shall not apply to subsequent continuous policy renewals without break.
impact_summary: No planned or medical illness hospitalization claims are payable during the first 30 days of a fresh policy, except immediate accidental trauma.

insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_text: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage: Cataract, Hysterectomy, Hernia, Hydrocele, Piles, Sinusitis, Gallstones, Kidney stones, and Joint Replacement Surgeries (unless arising directly from major accidental trauma).
impact_summary: Knee replacement, cataract surgery, and hernia repairs are strictly non-payable during the first 24 months of policy coverage even if diagnosed after policy inception.

insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_title: Section 1.1: Room Rent and Boarding Expenses
clause_text: Room, boarding and nursing expenses are covered up to Single Standard Private A/C Room for Sum Insured of ₹5,00,000 and above. There is no sub-limit or percentage cap for Intensive Care Unit (ICU) charges. If the insured occupies a room category higher than Single Private (e.g. Deluxe Suite), proportionate deduction shall apply to associated medical and surgical billing components.
impact_summary: Single private room is fully covered with 0% capping. Upgrading to executive suite triggers proportionate deductions on doctor and OT fees.

insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_text: Expenses incurred for cataract surgery are subject to a maximum sub-limit of ₹25,000 per eye (for Sum Insured up to ₹5,00,000) and ₹35,000 per eye (for Sum Insured ₹7,50,000 to ₹15,00,000) per policy period.
impact_summary: Hospital bills for premium cataract procedures exceeding ₹35,000 per eye require out-of-pocket settlement by patient.

insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Co. Ltd.
section_reference: Part III - What We Will Not Pay, Clause 1
clause_text: All pre-existing conditions declared and accepted at the time of proposal shall be covered after a continuous waiting period of 36 months from the policy start date. Optional reduction to 24 months or 12 months is available on payment of additional actuarial premium upon underwriter approval.
impact_summary: Standard PED coverage commences after 36 months. No claim payable for declared chronic diseases before month 37.

insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Co. Ltd.
clause_title: Section 1.1: Zero Room Rent Capping Benefit
clause_text: No capping or room rent restriction applies across any Sum Insured options. The insured is entitled to choose any room category (including single private room, twin sharing, or general ward) without any proportionate deduction on associated hospital medical bills.
impact_summary: Zero proportionate deduction regardless of room tier chosen by the policyholder.

insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Co. Ltd.
section_reference: Part II - Insuring Clauses, Benefit 4 (Secure Benefit)
clause_text: 100% of Base Sum Insured is automatically restored instantly upon first claim, unlimited times in a policy year for related and unrelated illnesses after basic Sum Insured exhaustion.
impact_summary: Full sum insured re-charged instantly for subsequent hospitalizations during the policy term.

clause_text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Optional add-on 'PED Modification' allows reduction of waiting period to 12 months or 24 months subject to specific underwriting declaration and risk loading.
impact_summary: Claims relating to pre-existing conditions require 36 months continuous tenure without interruption.

clause_title: Section 2.5: Co-Payment Clause for Senior Citizens
clause_text: 0% mandatory co-payment for entry age up to 60 years. For individuals entering at age 61 or above, a mandatory 20% co-payment applies on each and every admissible claim amount unless waiver of co-payment option was selected at proposal inception.
impact_summary: Patients entering insurance at age 61+ bear 20% of admissible hospital bill out of pocket.

policy_name: IRDAI Master Directive on Non-Medical Consumables
insurer_name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
clause_title: IRDAI Annexure I: List of Non-Payable Hospital Consumables
clause_text: Expenses incurred on non-medical items such as PPE kits beyond standard cap, surgical gloves, aprons, cotton buds, sanitary pads, admission/registration administrative charges, diet charges for relatives, and pulse oximeter probes are designated non-payable items unless a specific 'Consumables Add-on Cover' is active in the policy.
impact_summary: Typically forms ₹8,000 – ₹25,000 of typical inpatient bills which cannot be settled cashless and must be paid by patient directly.
